title: Chicken Teriyaki Stir-Fry
instructions: 1. Cut chicken thighs into bite-size pieces. 2. Heat oil in a wok over high heat. 3. Stir-fry chicken until browned, about 5 minutes. 4. Add garlic and ginger, cook 1 minute. 5. Add soy sauce, mirin, and sugar; simmer until sauce thickens. 6. Toss in scallions and serve over rice.
ingredients: chicken thighs; soy sauce; ginger; scallions; garlic; mirin; sugar; vegetable oil

title: Classic Margherita Pizza
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 500F with a pizza stone inside. 2. Stretch dough into a 12-inch round. 3. Spread crushed tomatoes, leaving a 1-inch border. 4. Top with fresh mozzarella and a drizzle of olive oil. 5. Bake 8-10 minutes until crust is golden. 6. Top with fresh basil before serving.
ingredients: pizza dough; crushed tomatoes; fresh mozzarella; fresh basil; olive oil; salt

title: Weeknight Black Bean Tacos
instructions: 1. Warm black beans with cumin and chili powder in a saucepan. 2. Char corn tortillas directly over a gas flame or in a dry skillet. 3. Fill tortillas with beans, then top with diced onion, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime.
ingredients: black beans; corn tortillas; cumin; chili powder; white onion; cilantro; lime
